verdict.rationale: Navan documents a REST API with retrieval and PATCH endpoints, an llms.txt file, and a hosted MCP server, but nothing in the evidence mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. The llms.txt file and the MCP server are adjacent AI-access features, not an API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
